lines.en: I hop along just above the grass tips.
My wings beat too fast to follow.
This path leads to the flower patch.
Three steps, then one hop.
Who left a pebble in the path?
I go around the ant procession.

lines.zh: 风吹草低，我就露出来了。
lines.en: The wind bends the grass and reveals me.
I hop over a little ditch.
I hum a song as I go.
My heels never touch down; it saves effort.
I visit this clover patch every day.
I step on leaves on purpose, loudly.
I sit on a mushroom swinging my feet.

lines.zh: 口袋里空空，什么都没有。
lines.en: My pockets are empty, nothing at all.

lines.zh: 我拨弄一根草，拨了半天。
lines.en: I fiddle with a grass blade for ages.
A beetle is tumbling about.
I count petals and lose track.
Who shall I tease today?
I yawn, very small.
My wings are drying in the sun.
I hear someone chopping wood far off.
I try a handstand and fail.
Grass seeds stick to my dress.
I look at myself in a puddle.
I daydream until the sun leans west.
I wait for someone to come play.

lines.zh: 我哼着歌，把草叶打了个结。
lines.en: Humming, I tie a grass blade in a knot.

lines.zh: 我数蚂蚁，数到第七只就忘了。
lines.en: I count ants and forget at the seventh.

lines.zh: 你的鞋好大，能借我穿吗？
lines.en: Your shoes are huge; may I borrow them?

lines.zh: 我飞到你眼前，看得清吗？
lines.en: I fly before your eyes; can you see me?
Your scabbard stands out more than you.
Why do you not fly? What a waste.
I tug at your sleeve.

lines.zh: 你低头，我就往上升一点。
lines.en: When you stoop, I rise a little.
Can your hat hide things?
Do not be scared when I laugh.

lines.zh: 我们互相看着，谁也不眨眼。
lines.en: We stare at each other, neither blinking.
Are you looking for something?

lines.zh: 我认识你吗？大概不认识。
lines.en: Do I know you? Probably not.

lines.zh: 你的影子好长，我藏在里面。
lines.en: Your shadow is long; I hide inside it.
I flew three circles around you.
You look like excellent teasing material.
Ow, you hit my wing.
I fell and flew up again.
It hurts, but it passes.
Nothing will drop off me.
You broke my candy jar.
I hold grudges; just you wait.
Call that a win? It does not count.
I hide in the flowers; you cannot find me.

lines.zh: 翅膀歪了，飞得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: My wing is bent; I fly crooked.
Once more and I will hit back.
Sweet! Sweet is my favorite.

lines.zh: 你手里的浆果给我一颗。
lines.en: One berry from your hand, please.
I keep honey hidden in a tree hollow.
I can trade you a pebble for it.
Do not wave it; I cannot see where it lands.
I fly over and take just one bite.
This candy will keep me happy all day.

lines.zh: 你的手别合上，我还没拿。
lines.en: Do not close your hand; I am not done.
The sweetness is stronger than the flowers.
I have landed on your wrist.
You knocked me flying; I am fine.
I bumped your nose; sorry.
Do not walk so fast.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，像两片叶子。
lines.en: We collided like two leaves.
I bounced off and rolled over.
Your knee left my head spinning.

lines.zh: 我踩在你鞋尖上歇会儿。
lines.en: I rest a moment on your shoe tip.

lines.zh: 亮晶晶的翅膀擦到你了吧。
lines.en: My shiny wings brushed you, didn't they?
After the bump we both laughed.

lines.zh: 绕一大圈，也花不了多少力气。
lines.en: A wide detour costs me little effort.
Will you make mischief with me?
Let us split one candy.

lines.zh: 你走得慢，我就落在你帽上。
lines.en: You walk slowly, so I ride your hat.
Let us settle in that tree hollow.
I will braid you a grass ring.
Let us startle the passersby together.
Do not mind that I am noisy.
Pinky promise, no taking it back.
One smile from you and I will know.
Before sunset, I will come again.
I keep this berry for later.
This glass bead goes into my keeping.
I cannot carry this; never mind.
I picked up a button.
Whose thread end is this?
I hide it in the tree hollow.
Dropped it; it rolled into the grass.
I found another one, just the same.
Holding things, I cannot fly high.
Let go; that fell from my pocket.

lines.zh: 有个东西在草丛里喘气。
lines.en: Something is breathing in the grass.
Who crushed my mushroom?
Those flowers have been broken.
A cat is watching my tree hollow.
Its shadow falls on me, huge.
I heard a bowstring.
It is rifling through my stash.
This smells of rust and smoke.
A hand reaches into the flowers.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的光收紧了，我盯住你。
lines.en: The light on my wings narrows; I have my eyes on you.
I quietly slip behind it.
That is the one, no doubt.

lines.zh: 我在它头顶上转，它跟不上。
lines.en: I circle overhead; it cannot keep up.
I pull a grass blade and creep closer.

lines.zh: 它一抬头，我就躲到叶后。
lines.en: When it looks up, I hide behind a leaf.
I still my wings and listen.
Its hand trembles; it fears me.
Its shoulder moved; it is turning.
This close, I hold my breath.
It has not found me; wonderful.
I finish counting three in my head.

lines.zh: 它挪半步，我贴上去半步。
lines.en: It shifts half a step; I match it.
I hold a pebble in my fist.

lines.zh: 风从它背后吹，味道送过来。
lines.en: The wind comes from behind it, carrying scent.
Now, strike, and do not hesitate.

lines.zh: 我把石子扔中了它的额头。
lines.en: My pebble struck its forehead.
I yanked its hair and ran.
Not a heavy blow, but very annoying.
It swung and missed; I laughed aloud.
I am small; this is all I can do.
Done, I fly up high.
It caught my wing.
I bit once, very lightly.
Stop chasing; you cannot catch me.
That is enough for today.
I popped out of a flower bud.
I opened my eyes to grass.

lines.zh: 这朵花是我出生的地方。
lines.en: This flower is where I was born.
My wings just grew; let me test them.
There are flowers here; I like it.
There is nothing in my pockets.
First flight, a bit crooked.
Any kin here? I will call out.
Good sun; I will bask first.
I stepped on a little mushroom.
This world is very big.
Where did I come from? Not important.
First, find something sweet.
I intend to play here a long while.
My wing tip is smoking; I run.
I landed in the grass face first.
I cannot float; I kick my legs.
A boom threw me far away.

lines.zh: 一根细箭穿过我的翅膀。
lines.en: A thin arrow passed through my wing.
This light has pinned me in place.
My stomach growls and the candy is gone.
The thunder scared me into falling.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，我飘着。
lines.en: Nothing below; I am drifting down.
